---
description: Design craft rules for UI code
applyTo: "**/*.tsx,**/*.jsx,**/*.vue,**/*.svelte,**/*.html,**/*.css,**/*.scss"
---

When writing or editing UI code, follow disciplines/12-design-craft.md in
full. Non-negotiable core: plan before pixels (subject, token palette,
deliberate type pairing, one signature element); run the anti-default
critique before building; first-run onboarding for new users; tooltips on
icon-only and non-obvious controls only; empty, loading, error, and success
states for every view; feedback within about 100ms for every action;
destructive actions guarded. Quality floor, always: responsive to mobile,
visible keyboard focus, WCAG AA contrast, reduced motion respected.
Microcopy uses the user's vocabulary, and buttons say exactly what happens.
